column1: # mapping_set_description: 'Maps the components defined in the Model Openness Framework (MOF) to classes and properties in the SPDX 3.0.1 specification. Uses expanded bridge concepts to map documentation and code correctly. Derived from the SPDX 3.1-dev mapping (tools/derive_spdx30.py): SPDX 3.1 is backward compatible with 3.0, so every target that exists in 3.0.1 is mapped the same way; targets added in 3.1 (Core/version, Core/intendedUse, isoAutomationLevel, byteSize, finetunedOn / pretrainedOn / validatedOn / evaluatedOn, conformsTo / Specification, SupportRelationship, ContactPointRelationship, InteractionTemplate, the Hardware profile) are replaced by the closest 3.0.1 carrier or recorded as GAP rows.'
